text: Not a subscriber to the channel but really resepct your work.  As for empathizing with people outside of AI circles, the advice given has one major missing piece, and here it is...iPhone users can use Dots to access Mail, iMessages, Photos, and Apple Notes.  Muse can't.  Grok Bot cannot.  Muse can't even plug into private Facebook photos or anything other than public Instagram photos. No Google photos access either.  Definitely not Apple photos.  Muse told me to add photos to my Google Drive and it could access them there.  Really?  As a non-technical heavy user of AI I add screenshots to my photos all of the time to share design and even researched technical information with Claude, Codex, Grok Heavy, Cursor, Gemini, and even Hermes.  Claude and ChatGPT are the only ones who have access to Apple photos.  I know how to take screenshots and paste them in the chat, but why change what works for me. That is the value of machines getting smarter.  It isn't a "Bitter Lesson" for me to let machines solve the problems.  I think Dots just solved another BIG problem that "normies" like me have been waiting for.
